summary: Make governed pull-request resume mutation-free and collision-safe

delivery.outcome: Governed pull-request resume is mutation-free and canonical remote branch publication is independent of stale local branch aliases
nonGoals: No raw push bypass or weakening of exact-ticket candidate validation
No automatic deletion, force-reset or overwrite of local branches or worktrees
No change to direct-main, publish-only, release, tag or registry semantics
No version, dependency, README badge or changelog mutation

architecture.decision: Classify a committed candidate before mutation-capable bootstrap, isolate Goal-owned PR metadata refresh, and push immutable HEAD through an explicit canonical remote refspec
architecture.rollback: Revert the unmerged ticket branch; callers retain the existing manual merged-branch cleanup and GOAL_SKIP_COSTS_BADGE workaround

validation.evidence: Committed-candidate resume bypasses bootstrap and unrelated mutation while preserving tests and revalidation
PR bootstrap and commit suppress cost badge changes without exposing Goal controls to project tests
Explicit HEAD-to-remote refspec succeeds despite local alias collision and remains non-forced

commands: ruff check goal/governance/delivery.py goal/push/core.py tests/test_governance_delivery.py tests/test_delivery_integrity.py
